hermes_risk_feed.summary: The Federal Reserve executed its first interest rate hike since 2023 amid persistent inflation, introducing a tightening headwind as the 10-year Treasury yield climbs near 5 percent. Despite this monetary policy shock, major US equity indices absorbed the news positively with moderate gains.
